//: Build profiles for EAS (Expo Application Services).
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS
Expo Go — the app you scan a QR code with — only ever supports the newest
Expo SDK. When it does not support this project's SDK, no amount of
updating it helps, and the only route onto a phone is a real build.
It is also the route the company needs regardless: seven representatives
cannot install Expo Go and scan a QR code every morning.
WHICH PROFILE TO USE
development  While building the app. Includes the developer menu and
connects to `npx expo start`. Install once, then it behaves
like Expo Go but supports this exact project.
preview      What you give the seven representatives to trial. A normal
standalone app. Android produces an .apk you can send by
link; no app store involved.
production   A store submission. Only needed if the company ever decides
to publish publicly, which for an internal app it should not.
Android needs nothing but a free Expo account. iOS needs a paid Apple
Developer account (US$99/year) — Apple does not allow installing an
unsigned app by any route.
See docs/81-device-testing.md and docs/82-production-deployment.md.
